name: Dried skimmed milk
definition: Nonfat milk powder used in historical food assistance and feeding mixtures.
preparation: Water if reconstituted; may be incorporated into cooked foods.

name: Corn-soy-milk
definition: Maize, soy and milk-based mixture for supplementary feeding.

name: Wheat-soy-milk
definition: Wheat, soy and milk-based mixture for supplementary feeding.

name: Instant corn-soy-milk
definition: Instantized version of CSM designed to simplify preparation.

name: Corn-soy blend
definition: Maize and soy flour enriched with micronutrients.

name: Wheat-soy blend
definition: Wheat and soy flour enriched with micronutrients.

name: UNIMIX
definition: Cereal-legume blend used in supplementary feeding; formulation varies.

name: Soy-fortified sorghum grits
definition: Processed sorghum enriched with soy and, in some specifications, micronutrients.

name: High-energy biscuits
definition: Energy-dense fortified biscuits for immediate food assistance.

name: BP-5
definition: Compressed fortified emergency ration; not a therapeutic food equivalent.
preparation: Eat directly or prepare as porridge according to label.

name: F-75
definition: Formula providing about 75 kcal/100 mL, used during stabilization of complicated severe malnutrition.
preparation: Safe water for powder; supervised clinical use.

name: F-100
definition: Formula providing about 100 kcal/100 mL, used during nutritional rehabilitation in appropriate clinical settings.
preparation: Safe water for powder; supervised clinical use.

name: Ready-to-use therapeutic food
definition: Energy-dense fortified food for treatment of severe wasting under appropriate protocols.
preparation: No mixing or cooking; safe drinking water needed.

name: Ready-to-use supplementary food
definition: Fortified lipid-based supplement used in management of moderate wasting.
preparation: No mixing or cooking; safe drinking water needed.

name: Corn-soy blend plus (Super Cereal)
definition: Fortified maize-soy flour for supplementary or general nutrition programs; exact formulation varies.

name: Super Cereal Plus
definition: Improved fortified cereal-soy blend containing milk, designed for nutritionally vulnerable groups including young children.

name: Small-quantity lipid-based nutrient supplement
definition: Small daily amount of fortified lipid-based food used to complement diets.

name: Medium-quantity lipid-based nutrient supplement
definition: Intermediate-size lipid-based supplement providing energy and micronutrients; intended use varies by specification.
